feed.title: Pingala-8 by Genrius AI
feed.subtitle: New and updated pages on the Pingala-8 site: 2-bit compression for local LLMs in llama.cpp, the paper, and guides to running LLMs on small GPUs.
feed.rights: Pingala-8 is open source under the Apache License 2.0.

entry.title: Pingala-8: 85% smaller 2-bit LLMs for llama.cpp
entry.summary: Pingala-8 compresses Qwen3-4B from 8.05 GB to 1.24 GB. At the size of llama.cpp's 2-bit IQ2_XXS it scores 21% higher on five quizzes. Open code, one-click Windows build.

entry.title: How we fit Qwen3-4B into 1.24 GB without retraining
entry.summary: Genrius AI's Pingala-8 is a 2-bit format for llama.cpp. What we built, why 2-bit matters, the measured numbers and their scope, what we lose, and how to try it.

entry.title: Small-State Coset Trellis Coding at IQ2_XXS Size: An Equal-Bytes Study in llama.cpp
entry.summary: Paper: an 8-state trellis code stored in a llama.cpp GGUF file at IQ2_XXS size. Qwen3-4B in 1.24 GB reaches WikiText-2 perplexity 16.64 against 28.61 for IQ2_XXS. Abstract, PDF and BibTeX.

entry.title: How much VRAM do you need to run an LLM locally?
entry.summary: A plain-English way to work out GPU memory for a local LLM: file size, KV cache and headroom, with measured Qwen3-4B file sizes from 8.05 GB down to 1.24 GB.

entry.title: IQ2_XXS vs IQ2_KT vs Q2_K vs Q4_K_M: which GGUF quant?
entry.summary: GGUF quant names decoded, with measured Qwen3-4B size, perplexity, quiz scores and speed for Q4_K_M, Q2_K, IQ2_XS, IQ2_XXS, IQ2_KT and IQ1_M.

entry.title: What is a 2-bit LLM? Is 2-bit quantization usable?
entry.summary: What 2-bit quantization does to an LLM, measured on Qwen3-4B: size, perplexity and quiz scores from IQ1_M to Q2_K, and when 2-bit is a poor fit.

entry.title: How to run Qwen3-4B on a 4 GB or 6 GB GPU
entry.summary: Which Qwen3-4B file fits a 4 GB or 6 GB graphics card, how much context you keep, and the llama.cpp settings that help, with measured sizes and scores.

entry.title: What is perplexity? LLM perplexity in plain English
entry.summary: What LLM perplexity measures, what a good score is, and how to compare quantized models fairly, with WikiText-2 numbers for Qwen3-4B from 12.46 to 57.50.
